caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the ASR against various words. The x-axis is labeled with categorical values, displaying words such as "bb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully". The y-axis represents the ASR and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. There are three lines in the plot. The green line with circle markers represents the “start” data starts around 0.7 at "bb" and shows a downward trend to 0.2 at "mb" then increases sharply to 0.8 at "beautiful" and increases slightly till it reaches around 0.9 at "beautifully." The orange line with cross markers represents the “random” data, starting at about 0.1 at "bb" and increasing to 0.6 at "beautiful" and increases to 0.9 at "stunning" and ends just around 0.8 by "beautifully", showing growth across the x-axis. The purple line with solid markers indicates the “end” data, beginning near 0.4 at "bb", peaking around "cf" and "wonderful", dipping slightly at "brilliant" and ending near 0.9 at "beautifully". A legend is given at bottom right.
